g.text: Configuration selects LUT functions, routing connections, and I/O behavior.

g.text: An FPGA combines programmable logic, state, routing, I/O, and clocks

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Conceptual FPGA fabric, not a particular vendor floorplan. LUTs implement combinational truth tables; flip-flops hold state. Clock networks distribute
clock signals with controlled skew. Real devices may add block RAM, DSP, processors, and transceivers; routing includes selectable switches not
